name: Endpoint Apps - Unauthorized - GenAI [is]
description: Intent: Endpoint apps that implement GenAI capabilities but are explicitly prohibited — populate with app-name patterns of unauthorized desktop GenAI clients (e.g., unsanctioned local LLM runners, a competitor AI assistant). Currently unconsumed — staged for future per-app GenAI segmentation beyond the [CH]-curated baseline; expected consumer surface is the M5030 / W5000 / B5000 endpoint-app pipeline. Exclusions: do not duplicate the [CH] curated GenAI list — extend the customer list only for org-specific prohibitions; do not add legitimate developer tooling (Copilot, Cursor) unless your policy truly prohibits them.
